findings.label: Currency None-masking re-introduced at DB layer
findings.detail: products.py line 77 applies .get("currency", "USD") when constructing the ProductResult row. Products with currency=None are stored with "USD" in the DB even though the in-memory dict correctly carries None. Audit whether any downstream read path uses ProductResult.currency for constraint evaluation; align the persisted value with the in-memory representation or use an explicit sentinel.

findings.label: Null price causes DB integrity error at runtime
findings.detail: ProductResult.price is Numeric(10,2), nullable=False. If Channel3 returns a product with no price, price=None passes through the wrapper and the router inserts NULL into a NOT NULL column, raising an IntegrityError on db.commit() after the loop has partially executed. Filter out data_complete=False products (or products with price=None) before the persistence loop.

findings.label: Dead data_complete argument in _normalize()
findings.detail: _normalize() passes data_complete=False to NormalizedProduct(...), but the model_validator always overwrites it. Remove the argument — the schema default is False and the comment already documents the validator owns it.
